senses.definition: The washing, colouring, cutting and styling of the hair; the art or trade of a hairdresser.
senses.example: There was also hairdressing: hairdressing, too, really was hairdressing in those times — no running a comb through it and that was that. It was curled, frizzed, waved, put in curlers overnight, waved with hot tongs;[…].

senses.definition: present participle and gerund of hairdress
